body.intent: Fix A change set that updates a node and then retires it cannot land: buildRetire (internal/api/write_node.go ~356) bases the node.retire op on the node's landed version (n.Version), ignoring the update this change set has pending on that node. At land the retire then counts as a stale base against its own change set's update. Evidence: change set 01M6WMCCRC0K (ship-change conflict fix, PR #383, green) fails land with 'model: conflict: base 01M68581Q6V7XS1VHP9Q4F011R of 01M68581Q6V7XS1VHP9Q48KQJS is stale: op 01M6WMRS1ZPY of change set 01M6WMCCRC0K since wrote field:acceptance, field:statement, handle'. Op 01M6WMRS1ZPY renames and updates the node, then op 01M6WMSB28 retires it on the old base. The same happens on node 01M6A0NG..CSVTX3B (ops ..3TSKP9 then ..34BK9A). No CLI path recovers: set --rebase refuses a retired node, retire refuses an already-retired node, and carve only moves nodes created in the source. Fix both: (1) retiring a node with pending updates in the same change set drops those updates (as it already does for a pending create) and bases the retire on the landed version; (2) land/fold accept an existing log where a change set's later op's base is superseded only by its own earlier op on the same node, so 01M6WMCCRC0K lands as it is. Add tests for update-then-retire and for the existing log shape. After it ships, retry run 01M6X2EMMHKMQ9W4TDJH3ERXSD (merge main into cs/fix-ship-change-stops-on-a first).
